modules.module_title: Proper use of scissor and any other related tools

pcs.pc_description: cleans the carpet and remove dust particles on the surface.
clip the loops of the carpet, if any.
cuts the pile (cut or loop pile) using a scissor to create engraved appearance.
ensure the engraving does not damage the base of the rug.
adjusts own position on the carpet for effective clipping and carving.

modules.module_title: Create engraved or flat surface as required

pcs.pc_description: carves and trims the pattern diligently with a scissor to ensure proper appearance of design.
ensure that the shape to be engraved should not be mixed up with yarn of the adjacent area.
ensure that the carved and trimmed yarns do not overlap or mix up with another design.
comply with the requirements of the buyer or the instructions given by the supervisor.
